summary: Backend-only regression testing of the iter328 Founder × Product-Feed audit endpoint (GET /api/admin/integrations/enrichlabs/founder-feed-audit). Ran the pre-existing pytest and added a companion regression suite covering (a) /feed.csv contract unchanged, (b) live-data summary math invariant, (c) canonical row shape, (d) bad-token rejection. All 7 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Diagnostic endpoint is correctly read-only and mirrors the exact filter rules used by _fetch_feed_products (published + non-deleted + in_stock truthy + image_url or images[]). Confirmed by seeding 4 founders across every classifier branch and asserting the produced reason strings.

Preview DB currently has founders_total=15 and founders_in_feed=15 (zero excluded), so the 23-missing-founders situation reported in prod cannot be reproduced in Preview — this is a DATA condition, not a code bug. Once main agent runs this endpoint against prod, the reason_histogram will surface exactly why each founder is missing (opt_out / no products / draft only / OOS / no image / deleted).
enrichlabs.py is 1131 lines — still readable but nearing the 700-line split guideline. Not urgent, but worth queuing a modularization pass once the freeze lifts.
test_credentials: Admin JWT via maker_auth.issue_admin_magic_token(OPS_EMAIL) → POST /api/admin/auth/verify. OPS_EMAIL and ENRICHLABS_API_KEY loaded from /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: test_audit_classifies_every_founder_state seeds 4 makers (slugs prefixed audit-<run>-{ok,optout,noprod,draftonly}) plus their products; deleted in finally block on both pass/fail. No residual test data in DB (verified — cleanup executed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Preview DB has 15 founders all with valid feed rows, so live-data assertions in test_iter328_founder_feed_audit_extra.py only verify invariants (math + row shape), not the specific prod discrepancy. If prod-parity data is loaded into Preview later, the same tests will still hold. Feed CSV must be pulled with header 'X-EnrichLabs-Key' (NOT X-API-Key / Bearer).
rca_of_the_issue: The 30-vs-7 Founders-Wall-vs-Feed gap the user reported is expected schema behavior — Founders Wall counts all tier='founder' makers, whereas the Enrichlabs feed only includes makers with at least one product that is (published AND in-stock AND has an image AND maker did not toggle external_ads_opt_out AND maker is not soft-deleted). The new /founder-feed-audit endpoint enumerates every founder with a plain-English reason and correctly reproduces the classifier logic — verified via 4 seeded fixtures each hitting a distinct exclusion branch.
